title: Create a price list
text: A price list is an extra price for the same item, such as Reseller or Employee. It appears as a new column in the table.
steps: Click Sidebar > Products, then Price Lists.
Click New Price List, type a name, and click Save.
The new column starts empty. Fill it in only for the products that need it.

title: Set prices for one product
text: Quick Edit lets you change all prices for one product in one window.
steps: Click Products in the sidebar, then Price Lists.
Find the product. Use the search box or scan it.
Click the arrow at the end of the row, then Quick Edit.
Type each price, then click Save.
Retail is locked here. Change it from the Product List page.

title: Reprice many products at once
text: Bulk Edit Price Lists opens a table for changing prices across many products.
steps: Click Products in the sidebar, then Price Lists.
Click Bulk Edit Price Lists in the top bar.
Type the new prices. Leaving a box empty removes that price; it does not set it to zero.
Click Save Changes. Nothing is saved until you do this.

title: Copy prices from another branch
text: Import prices from another branch to update the products this branch also sells.
steps: Click Products in the sidebar, then Price Lists.
Click Bulk Edit Price Lists, then Import, then From another branch.
Choose the branch to copy from, then confirm.
Click Save Changes to keep the copied prices.

title: Import prices from a file
text: Download the price template, fill it in, then import it back. Products are matched by barcode, and only the prices change.
steps: Click Products in the sidebar, then Price Lists.
Click Print & Export and download the price template.
Fill in a price for each barcode in the correct column.
Click Print & Export again and import the file. No products are created and stock is not changed.

title: Use price lists at the register
text: Price lists appear at the register only when the branch has Wholesale & Multi-Price Tiers turned on.
steps: Click Settings in the sidebar, then Cashier Settings.
Turn on Enable Wholesale & Multi-Price Tiers mode.
Choose the price tier setting: Ask for each item or One tier for the cart.
Click Save. The Wholesale Price field will also appear on the product form.

title: Rename or delete a price list
text: In the left panel, a pencil icon renames the price list and a trash icon deletes it.
steps: Click Products in the sidebar, then Price Lists.
Find the price list in the left panel.
Click the pencil to rename it or the trash icon to delete it.
Deleting removes that column from every product. This action cannot be undone.
